scope: Native primary whole-stack carried-bag relocation and different-template swaps, fresh and complete-graph storage. Source-derived encrypted fresh TCP, native graph transfer/recovery, no original-client executable acceptance.

source_authority.contract: Five BYTE request. Missing source bag 2, missing/zero source item 3, missing destination bag 1, same position 4. Whole moves clamp requested count; different templates swap entire stacks. Source DEL/ADD or two ordered UPDATEs precede one MOVEITEM success.
Different template IDs guarantee CTItem inequality. Whole-stack Copy with remaining count 0 preserves the original ID. Copy retains counts, raw magic and extensions.
FindTItem looks up an arbitrary BYTE without capacity validation. GetBlankPos uses pinned template bSlotCount. Modern accepted requests additionally enforce that capacity.
MOVEITEM carries one result byte. UPDATE/ADD carry the bag plus full original item descriptor; DEL carries bag and slot.
Original MOVEITEM opcode 0x52A8 and five-byte body; MOVEITEM 0x52A9, UPDATE 0x52AA, ADD 0x52AB, DEL 0x52AC.
Source inventory sentinels and move result values are preserved.

pinned_content.historical_mutations: None. Only owned synthetic mutable account/character fixtures are changed. Backups and existing migration hashes are preserved.

implementation.planner: Resolve source bag/item and original error ordering, then destination/same position. A complete stack moves without a new ID. Different templates exchange complete stacks even for count 1. Unsupported splits, same-template merges/swaps, drops and equipment fail before mutation.
implementation.capacity: Fresh and transfer hydration load bSlotCount from pinned TITEMCHART into a server-only field. The repository revalidates bag metadata/type/capacity in the transaction. Only permanent carried bags are supported; invalid positions close without success instead of reproducing the original unchecked-slot behavior.
implementation.projection: Freeze the character and copy its immutable payload; move only bag/slot, keep raw server item attributes and identity, sort destination slots. Compare complete before-plus-move and after encodings to reject unrelated item/core/skill changes.
implementation.fresh_storage: Account, primary claim and recovery receipt fence the transaction. Lock and verify affected owned row fingerprints, counts, templates and original positions. Confirm empty destination remains empty; uniqueness also rejects competing inserts. Update only dwStorageID and bItemID; defer and then validate the existing slot uniqueness constraint for swaps.
implementation.graph_storage: Check full stored graph hash, catalog receipts and original core. Compare the complete candidate before graph allowing only live core and sampled skill durations; preserve ranks and unrelated graph fields. Moved raw IDs retain all uint64 bits. Store only the updated authoritative checkpoint, never stale normalized item rows.
implementation.audit: Migration 027 adopts the existing item_slot index as DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE and creates inventory_movements. One movement receipt per relocated item shares operation_id for a swap, exact row or raw-item hashes and graph hashes for contract 2. Item counts are unchanged. Identity-sequence gaps on rollback are expected.
implementation.publication: All positions, live core, sampled skill timers, recovery state and receipts commit before private DEL/ADD or ordered UPDATEs and one MOVEITEM success. Periodic capture cannot overwrite the frozen plan. Live cooldowns are neither restarted nor charged by a move.
implementation.unknown_outcome: No retry. Close without success, retain the reservation and refuse stale final save. Disconnect during a confirmed commit publishes the committed state before teardown save.
implementation.deployment: Migrations 001-026 and both backups retain hashes. Apply 027 and updated map-runtime-grants.sql before these binaries. Map gains UPDATE only on the two position columns, INSERT on the movement ledger and USAGE on its sequence. Migration 027 is immutable after application; next 028. Local commits/images only, no GitHub publication.

release.scope: Installed Release Login/World/Map daemons; backend/pool integration executables mounted from the verified Debug build.

regression_before.scope: Previous installed multi-attack daemons with current mounted backend/pool executables and migrations. The old server has no native MOVEITEM handler and does not return the first required source error response.

limitations: Splitting, merging and same-template swaps, equipment, item dropping, timed bags and secure-code inventory state remain unsupported. Trade/store gameplay state is not yet active in the native path.

Fresh encrypted TCP verifies requests/errors, cross-bag moves/swaps, exact full descriptors/order, delayed commit, quantity/field conservation, capacity/split refusal and relogin. Native service fixtures additionally verify graph transfers, return promotion and process replacement/relogin; new inventory TCP through two Maps remains pending.
Equipment and durability mutations with derived-stat/timing invalidation, active effects, full combat and actual original-client acceptance remain unfinished.
